WITH trans_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    tr.transreg,
    tr.ordertypedist,
    AVG(sf.shortintrt) as avg_short_interest,
    AVG(sf.optvolrt) as avg_option_volume_ratio
  FROM transactionrecord tr
  INNER JOIN sentimentandfundamentals sf ON sf.transref = tr.transreg
  GROUP BY tr.transreg, tr.ordertypedist
),
with_ratio AS (
  SELECT 
    transreg,
    ordertypedist,
    avg_short_interest,
    avg_option_volume_ratio,
    CASE 
      WHEN AVG(avg_short_interest) OVER (PARTITION BY ordertypedist) IS NOT NULL
      THEN avg_short_interest / AVG(avg_short_interest) OVER (PARTITION BY ordertypedist)
      ELSE NULL
    END as short_interest_ratio
  FROM trans_avg
)
(
  SELECT *
  FROM with_ratio
  WHERE short_interest_ratio IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY short_interest_ratio DESC
  LIMIT 10
)
UNION ALL
(
  SELECT *
  FROM with_ratio
  WHERE short_interest_ratio IS NULL
)
